natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Current data shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging improved week-one engagement and drove meaningful product action—directly addressing the activation decline. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification worked, but activation_messaging is the more immediate lever for the current activation drop. Verifying these two memories will confirm the magnitude and durability of messaging impact. Memory_44 supports why we should not pursue enterprise_sales_assist (already known to work but not addressing the SMB activation problem). We avoid promotional_pricing despite competitive pressure because memory_73 showed -12% retention risk at 40% off, threatening long-term qualified revenue despite short-term signup gains. Referral_incentive works well for established customers (memory_57) but won't solve the activation problem for new accounts. Activation messaging is targeted, testable in one week, and directly counters the observed QoQ decline without retention risk. Standard_experiment scale allows controlled learning before broader rollout.
